blocks.text: An antipersonnel land mine believed to have washed ashore from North Korea was discovered on a beach in Ganghwa-gun, Incheon, last Thursday, prompting authorities to urge residents and visitors to exercise caution. According to Ganghwa officials on Friday, the mine was found around 3:20 p.m. Thursday near Daebinchang Beach on Jumun Island, Seodo-myeon, by an environmental cleanup worker. The worker immediately reported the discovery to the relevant authorities. The Marine Corps’ 2nd Division dispatched an explosive ordnance disposal team to the scene.
